A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
amino acids 185 to 267, which contain four membrane-spanning regions, are sufficient and necessary to target a protein to the peroxisome.

The main takeaway from our work is that

PMP47 does not have a single peroxisomal-targeting signal, as is the case with many other peroxisomal matrix proteins, but that the protein has multiple domains that contribute to its localization to the organelle.
